protocol.feed: belts: generous = one item on each lane every tick (more than a fast belt carries); throttled = perMinute/3600 a tick, alternating lanes. pipes: generous = the outside pipe kept full; throttled = perMinute/3600 a tick plus what was refused, at most one second saved
protocol.take: packs: everything in the two chests once a second; stone: everything on the exit tile every four ticks
